name: Windows AutoRun Commands Disabled
description:
Ensures autorun.inf commands are never executed (NoAutorun = 1).
Required Windows permission (remedy only): LEA agent account must be allowed to run only: reg add HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer /v NoAutorun (administrator rights) via a delegated run-as permission, Scheduled Task, or service configuration.

remedy.command: reg add HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer /v NoAutorun /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f | Out-Null; reg query HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer /v NoAutorun
